topics.topic: Accepted api_base_url forms and exact URL-join construction semantics
questions: Which additional `api_base_url` forms are valid (path/query/fragment/userinfo), and exactly how must the final URL be built in those cases?

topics.topic: Deterministic first-failing manifest shape/type check and its classification when fields have wrong types
questions: When manifest fields exist but have wrong types (for example `capabilities` not an array, entries not objects, header maps not object-of-strings), which exact check fails first and with what classification?

topics.topic: Exact string rendering of integer path-placeholder values before percent-encoding
questions: What exact textual form is used for integer placeholder values before percent-encoding?

topics.topic: Handling rules for malformed or ambiguous path-placeholder brace syntax
questions: How are malformed or ambiguous brace patterns handled (unmatched `{`/`}`, empty names, nested braces, or literal braces)?

topics.topic: How map_index values are ordered when sorting by (node_id, map_index)
questions: How is `map_index` compared (numeric ascending, string/code-point, or another rule)?

topics.topic: Whether admission with cleanup_failed must roll back entirely or may persist partial TrialExecutions without a verdict
questions: If `cleanup_failed` occurs during admission over multiple trial cases, does admission persist a partial set of TrialExecutions and no verdict, or must the whole admission call be rolled back to preserve 'never stops early'?

topics.topic: Whether failed executions from ended refused/cancelled runs are ever capturable when capture would be value-only
questions: Are failed executions from ended `refused`/`cancelled` runs always non-capturable, even when their captured inputs would be value-only (no file needed)?

topics.topic: Whether resume may consume an already approved-unused approval after the standing grant was revoked, or must require a new approval wait
questions: If a matching approved-unused approval exists but the standing grant was revoked, should resume use that approval or force a new approval wait?

topics.topic: Whether user function code may access files in the sandbox exchange directory under purity rules
questions: Should function code be allowed to read/write files inside the sandbox exchange directory, or should any filesystem access by user code be a violation?

topics.topic: Which EffectAttempt timestamp field maps to NodeExecution.started_at during in-flight recovery
questions: Which exact EffectAttempt field populates NodeExecution.started_at during in-flight recovery?
